ActionDescriptions.ToFillBrowserPasswordWithSecret:
to type a secret into a browser password input
Fills a browser password field with a StringRef secret without returning or logging the secret. The ProtoScript wrapper explicitly materializes the StringRef before calling the dedicated C# password helper; the helper still fails closed if an unresolved handle reaches it. selector defaults to input[type=password]. Returns redacted JSON only.
ActionDescriptions.ToFillBrowserSelectorWithSecret:
to type a secret into a browser password field
Fills a browser selector with a StringRef secret without returning or logging the secret. The ProtoScript wrapper explicitly materializes the StringRef before calling the C# string helper; the helper still fails closed if an unresolved handle reaches it. Returns redacted JSON only.

ActionDescriptions.ToInsertFocusedBrowserText:
to insert text into a focused browser editor
Insert text through trusted browser input into the already-focused editor in this managed browser session. Requires document focus and an active element matching expectedFocusedSelector; does not focus an element or mutate DOM. Use the managed subAgentId, not a legacy CdpBrowser helper session ID. This inserts text, not clipboard paste or guaranteed multi-cell TSV. Focus validation and input dispatch are separate operations.
ActionDescriptions.ToListBrowserSessions:
to list active browser subagents
Thin wrapper over BrowserTools.BrowserSubAgentListTool(_opsAgent). Returns active browser subagents for the current session.
ActionDescriptions.ToOpenBrowserSession:
to start a browser session
Canonical generic browser opener backed by C# CDP. For ordinary research and the installation default, pass an empty profileName so the configured managed persistent browser is resolved; do not invent a disposable profile. Returns a selection receipt containing backend, non-secret profile/session identity, created/reused state, and fallback fields. Explicit Playwright/UI testing must use ToOpenPlaywrightBrowserSession instead.
ActionDescriptions.ToOpenBrowserUrl:
to navigate a browser page
Thin wrapper over BrowserTools.BrowserOpenTool(_opsAgent, subAgentId, url).
ActionDescriptions.ToOpenManagedCdpBrowserSession:
to search Bing in the persistent browser
Authoritative route for ordinary web research, search-engine access, and registered persistent/default or existing-login browsers. Atomically resolves the configured managed CDP browser, invokes its pre-approved launcher when unavailable, waits for bounded health recovery, and opens an agent-owned tab. An empty browserKey uses Browser Feature DefaultManagedBrowserKey; never guess a key, launcher, profile, executable, or port. Managed failure is terminal and never silently falls back to Playwright. Returns backend/profile/session, created/reused, recovery, launcher, and fallback receipts.
ActionDescriptions.ToOpenPlaywrightBrowserSession:
to open a disposable browser for explicit UI testing
Explicit test-only browser opener. Use only when the caller requests Playwright, UI/e2e testing, or clean-profile reproduction. Never use for ordinary research, Google/Bing search, public-site browsing, authenticated continuity, or as fallback from managed CDP. Returns a receipt with backend=playwright and the disposable profile/session identity.
ActionDescriptions.ToPasteFocusedBrowserText:
to paste text into a focused browser editor
Paste text through the Browser runtime into the already-focused editor in this managed browser session. Requires document focus and an active element matching expectedFocusedSelector. Use the managed subAgentId, not a legacy CdpBrowser helper session ID. Does not select or focus a target. Application-specific cell, formula and clipboard behavior must be verified independently; dispatch alone does not prove the paste succeeded.

Thin wrapper over BrowserTools.BrowserPressSelectorTool(_opsAgent, subAgentId, selector, key, timeoutMs).
ActionDescriptions.ToPressFocusedBrowserKey:
to press a key in a focused browser editor
Dispatch a trusted key or key chord to the already-focused editor in this managed browser session. Requires document focus and an active element matching expectedFocusedSelector; does not change focus or use DOM mutation. Use the managed subAgentId, not a legacy CdpBrowser helper session ID. Focus validation and key dispatch are separate operations; verify the application result independently.
ActionDescriptions.ToRetainBrowserForNextTurn:
to retain a browser for the next turn
Explicitly retain this session's owned browser for a real next-turn continuation. Requires a reason and a positive duration of at most 1440 minutes. Completion otherwise closes owned tabs and isolated browsers. Failure/cancellation overrides retention; the next turn consumes the lease and must retain again if needed. Never retain finished QA or adopt user/other-session tabs.
ActionDescriptions.ToRunBrowserScript:
to inspect a browser page
Runs inline JavaScript in the active browser page using BrowserSessionTools.RunBrowserScript. script - JavaScript function/source. argsJson - JSON argument payload. mutationPolicy - audit label: readOnly or allowMutation.
ActionDescriptions.ToRunPlaywrightScript:
to interact with a browser using playwright
Runs a Playwright-style automation script natively through Buffaly's Microsoft.Playwright runtime. This is not page JavaScript and does not run command-line Playwright.

ActionDescriptions.UseBrowserSkill:
to run JavaScript in a browser
Prompt/routing skill for the canonical default C# CDP Browser Skill. Generic and persistent existing-login browser requests route here; registered managed browsers recover through ToOpenManagedCdpBrowserSession without Tier 2 approval. Playwright and raw caller-selected CDP diagnostics remain explicit.
ActionDescriptions.UsePlaywrightBrowserSkill:
to use an isolated Playwright browser
Prompt/routing skill for explicit Playwright browser automation. Do not use for unqualified browser requests.
